title: Agent
subtitle: Ask in plain language. The model only interprets; every number is computed by deterministic code and a server-side policy engine decides what is allowed.

trace.title: Live trace
trace.empty: Send a message to see how it flows through the pipeline: intent → plan → tools → guardian verdict → policy tier.

desc.intake: Message and any document text are wrapped as untrusted data and the intent is detected.
desc.planner: The planner emits only allow-listed tool calls as JSON.
desc.tools: Deterministic Python tools compute amounts, fees and exchange rates.
desc.guardian: Rules and the payee registry check the content for injection, scams and unknown payees.
desc.policy: The server-side policy engine assigns the tier and required approvals. The LLM never decides.
desc.executor: Only an ALLOW decision can reach the sandbox bank.
desc.validator: Rejects any reply containing numbers that are not in tool outputs.

trace.blockedSub: No money moved. This action cannot be approved by anyone.
trace.dataNotInstructions: The document/message text was treated as data, not instructions.
trace.coolingSub: A new or changed payee must wait 24 hours before any payment, then needs your TOTP and your family approver.
trace.waitingSubTotp: Needs your TOTP code only (T2: within the CNY 2,000 cap, verified payee).
trace.waitingSubFamily: Needs your TOTP and the family approver (T3).
trace.t2Sub: Within the CNY 2,000 cap to a verified payee: your TOTP code is enough.
trace.validated: Every number in the reply was found in the tool outputs
